findings.title: Raw projection revision compared to HTTP epoch revision
findings.cause: Expected owned profile spreads raw projection result including numeric revision5. Actual production index intentionally overrides revision with epoch-prefixed string. Equality must fail even with identical canonical content. Prior labelled test incorrectly copied the same numeric revision into its HTTP double.
findings.cheapReproduction: Loaded exact retained profile; assertSocialHTTPView with identical content and production epoch:string revision rejects. Source inspection proves production envelope type. No actual response body persisted, so no invented full response.
findings.repair: Exclude only raw projection revision from expected HTTP content at construction; independently validate actual envelope revision/checkpoint/schema/scope/completeness. Retain exact identity including current profile, posts, cursor, names and boards. Prefer actual production-index/HTTP composition regression over copied envelope.

findings.repair: Accept omitted params only for source-derived no-argument L1 method allowlist; preserve checks/inspection of all supplied fields and reject malformed params/unknown methods.
